source_budget.scope: Frozen cpu_budget code pins the current process before spawning collection workers; monitor code attempts to constrain observed descendants. This is not retrospective continuous observation of every child.

point_observation.scope: Single read-only observation of actual campaign Python root and currently live descendants; not a full-campaign resource measurement. Idle venv launcher is outside the monitored execution root.

production_reader_measurement.contention_scope: Measured concurrently with the recorded native collection jobs sharing logical CPUs0..3. These are observed contended-host rates, not dedicated-host or OS-cold rates.
production_reader_measurement.cache_scope: Selected compressed chunks are deliberately prefetched, intending warm OS cache. OS residency/eviction is not enforced or measured. The production decompressed-chunk LRU is cleared at each workload start, then retains at most four chunks.
production_reader_measurement.scope: Separate measured reader window, not a substitute for the missing complete collection resource series.

sdk_failure_is_separate.scope: Per-dataset startup failure preserved separately from the top-level observer error. No causal link to PID25004 is established.
